entities.name: Abdullah ibn Salam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdallah ibn Salam, born Al-Husayn ibn Salam, was a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, and a Jew who converted to Islam. He participated in the conquest of Syria and Palestine, but died in Medina.
